_readme: Written FTL rule / estimator overrides — the TOP of the v1.1 source hierarchy. Hand-maintained (NOT generated by scripts/build_rulebook_data.py, so a rebuild from FTL's workbook does not lose it). rules_engine.py upserts these rows over decision_rules.json / review_triggers.json / source_register.json by id. Keep this file byte-identical in FTL-Quote-Estimator and FTL-Qualifier.

overrides.source: Email 'Changes', Francine Lewis (FTL) to Seth, 2026-10-21 20:06 UTC; follow-up 'New Quote : Feedback', 2026-11-03
overrides.summary: Quote 1 pairs every operator with a defaulted panel adaptor; Quote 2 offers the matching universal car door.

decision_rules.trigger_spec_says: Quote 1 carries panel adaptors (existing doors retained, or the DOOR-006 default adaptor), or landing locks are converted to GAL
decision_rules.agent_action: Quote 2 (FTL recommended) offers the new Wittur universal car door matched to the operator's speed/type and width in place of the adaptor — e.g. 1S 42 in -> 1S_T1_UNIVERSAL_CAR_DOOR_PANEL - 42 X 84 (2C / 2T have their own codes, 2 panels per opening). Label it FTL recommended unless it is already spec-required (then it is in Quote 1).
decision_rules.required_inputs: Door type (1S/2C/2T), operator width, stocked 84 in universal door
decision_rules.human_review_if: Customer rejects new door; no stocked universal door for the type/width
decision_rules.authority: FTL explicit rule; amended by F. Lewis email 2026-10-21 (previously only when landing locks convert to GAL)

decision_rules.trigger_spec_says: Existing car door retained, customer declines new door, OR the RFQ does not state whether the car doors are retained or replaced
decision_rules.agent_action: Quote 1 pairs EACH operator with a panel adaptor on the line directly below it (line 1 operator, line 2 adaptor). Unless the RFQ or survey states the OEM / hand, DEFAULT to: type = the operator's (1S / 2T / 2C), OEM = GAL (most common), width = the operator's width, hand = the operator's hand (LH when unknown) — e.g. 1S 42 in LH operator -> SGV2(1S)_PANEL_ADAPTOR_GAL42_LH (FTL's own shorthand: SGV2(1S)_DP_GAL_42_LH — the _DP_ spelling is the pre-v1.1 name of the same product). Mark the line DEFAULT and keep the quote at REVIEW. A stated OEM with a stocked adaptor (GAL, MAC, DOVER) is used instead of the default.
decision_rules.required_inputs: Door OEM / existing car-door lock, hall-view hand, top-of-door bolt pattern — confirm at survey
decision_rules.human_review_if: Stated OEM has no stocked adaptor (e.g. OTIS, OTHER); stocked adaptor does not exist for the type/width; OEM statements conflict
decision_rules.authority: F. Lewis email 2026-10-21 (amends v1.1: previously no adaptor SKU until OEM and bolt pattern were known)

review_triggers.condition: Retained car door whose stated OEM has no stocked adaptor, or the type / width has no stocked adaptor, or OEM statements conflict
review_triggers.agent_response: No panel adaptor SKU is chosen; the opening is held. (When the OEM is simply not stated, the DOOR-006 default adaptor is priced and the quote is REVIEW, not BLOCK.)
review_triggers.required_resolution: Request OEM, top-of-door pattern and photos

source_register.file_source: Email 'Changes' — Francine Lewis, FTL Distribution (2026-10-21) and 'New Quote : Feedback' (2026-11-03)
source_register.role: Current written FTL rule / estimator override
source_register.primary_use: Default panel adaptor on Quote 1 (SGV2(1S)_DP_GAL_42_LH = inFlow SGV2(1S)_PANEL_ADAPTOR_GAL42_LH); matching universal car door on Quote 2 (1S_T1_UNIVERSAL_CAR_DOOR_PANEL - 42 X 84)
source_register.control_note: Top of the source hierarchy. Amends DOOR-005, DOOR-006 and RT-004.
